confirm.cancelMessage: Cancel this goods receipt? This cannot be undone.

confirm.inventoryInProgress: Updating inventory — please keep this page open until it finishes.
confirm.repostMessage: Add the stock for {{count}} line(s) that were never posted to inventory.
confirm.repostWarning: Only do this if the stock is genuinely missing from inventory. Lines already posted by this receipt are skipped automatically, but a receipt confirmed before mid-2026 carries no posting record — re-posting one of those would double-count. Check the inventory page if unsure.
